findings.evidence: The description lists 'sequence flows, class models, ER diagrams' but omits flowchart, decision tree, process and workflow requests, even though flowcharts are a supported route.
findings.fix: Create, edit and repair Mermaid diagrams in .mmd files or Markdown mermaid blocks. Use when asked to diagram, visualize, model or map a process, workflow, decision tree, flowchart, sequence, class model, ERD or database schema, state machine, C4 or infrastructure architecture, Gantt schedule, pie chart or Git branch history, or to repair Mermaid rendering or export, even when Mermaid is not named. Not for prose-only explanations, unchanged diagrams, PlantUML or draw.io work, matplotlib charts, or interactive diagram-canvas components.

findings.evidence: The rules assume 'a Markdown column ... of about 900px' and say to 'go left-to-right only for a row of three or four nodes,' even when the requested output is a presentation or other wide canvas.
findings.fix: Use the 900px column and top-down direction as defaults for Markdown documentation; let an explicitly supplied target canvas, renderer or readability requirement override them.

findings.evidence: 'Every `->>` call gets its `-->>` reply unless the user says it is fire-and-forget' conflicts with the grounding rule when a detailed source specifies a call but does not establish its reply.
findings.fix: Show a reply when the supplied facts establish it; otherwise label an inferred reply as an assumption or ask, rather than inventing an interaction.

findings.evidence: On a Chromium sandbox error the workflow automatically retries with '{"args":["--no-sandbox"]}', including when the diagram or its input source is untrusted.
findings.fix: Prefer a supported sandboxed renderer; explain the reduced isolation and obtain permission before using --no-sandbox, limiting that fallback to trusted inputs and an isolated environment.
